name: Form Components
description: Complete form system with Input, Textarea, Select, Checkbox, Radio, and Label components
usage_examples: <Checkbox label="Subscribe to newsletter" description="We'll send you updates weekly" />
<RadioGroup name="plan" value={selected} onChange={setSelected}><Radio value="monthly" label="Monthly" /><Radio value="yearly" label="Yearly" /></RadioGroup>

design_tokens.input_base: w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-white/5 border rounded-lg text-white placeholder-gray-500
design_tokens.label: block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-1.5

accessibility.errors: aria-invalid and aria-describedby for error messages
